change: GigSim policy v2 (our own change request; the instructor's 2 Nov update was not published): proposals must end with the AI-assistance disclosure sentence; +4 Connects when proposals_count > 20.
why_zero: pricing_strategist reads the live policy via the get_policy MCP tool into state.profile.policy; agent/nodes/compliance.py and agent/nodes/writer.py apply policy.required_disclosure from config or the live policy; Connects cost comes from get_job (GigSim applies the v2 formula).
